steps.en: Install Prefect and start a local API server with its UI
steps.zh: 安装 Prefect，启动带 UI 的本地 API 服务
steps.code: pip install -U prefect · prefect server start

steps.en: Decorate the functions of your existing script
steps.zh: 给现有脚本里的函数加上装饰器

steps.en: Reports each flow and task run's state and logs to the UI on port 4200
steps.zh: 把每次 flow、task 运行的状态和日志上报到 4200 端口的 UI

steps.en: Turn the flow into a scheduled deployment
steps.zh: 把 flow 变成一个定时部署

steps.en: The serving process polls for due runs, executes them and applies retries
steps.zh: 服务进程轮询到期的运行，执行并按声明重试

value.en: An ordinary Python script becomes a scheduled job with retries and a run history, without a rewrite
value.zh: 一段普通 Python 脚本不用重写，就成了带重试和运行记录的定时任务

sources: PrefectHQ/prefect README.md (main, retrieved 2026-10-08): pip install -U prefect; from prefect import flow, task; @task(log_prints=True); prefect server start, UI at http://localhost:4200; github_stars.serve(name="first-deployment", cron="* * * * *") — 'a process running locally that is looking for scheduled deployments'
